verdict.rationale: TaxJar explicitly tracks sales/transaction counts against economic nexus thresholds per state and surfaces progress (e.g., "$90k of $100k... 125 of 200") via a dedicated tool that "pinpoint[s] states where you've met economic nexus thresholds," implying proactive alerting before crossing. Missing for 10: explicit mention of country-level (international/VAT) threshold tracking and confirmation of push/email alert mechanics beyond the dashboard view.
